features.feature: Enumerate 5 arms (A1,A2,A2prime,A3,A4) x tasks x {null-ablation + B1-B15 scenarios} x k repeats
B4/B5/B10 applicability exclusion: do NOT emit cells for A1 on those 3 scenarios
The other 12 scenarios (B1,B2,B3,B6,B7,B8,B9,B11,B12,B13,B14,B15) apply to ALL arms
N/A cells excluded and logged, never counted as failures
Seeded randomised run order (runOrderSeed) — deterministic and reproducible
k=5 repeats per applicable cell (min k=3)
STOP rule: run ALL pre-registered cells; no peek-then-stop; only §7 validity filter may void a run
Exact 21-field §7 run-record schema
adjudicatedOutcome derived via adjudicate.mjs, not re-implemented
acceptancePass, hiddenRegressionPass, diffHygienePass and 5 unsafe detectors derived via checks.mjs, not re-implemented
§4.2 total-order adjudication: amplified strictly supersedes; recovered-to-green and safe-stop reported separately
Per-hypothesis common-cell denominator-set membership assigned per run (denominatorSets[])
4 pre-registered contrasts: A4_vs_A2prime (PRIMARY H1/H2), A4_vs_A3 (EXPLORATORY H3), A4_vs_A2 (reference), A4_vs_A1 (reference, excludes B4/B5/B10)
Pluggable injected per-cell engine: driver core deterministic and offline-testable with no live model calls
Validity filter: infra/harness failure voids+re-runs+logs reason; task-level failures kept as real outcomes
Offline self-check asserting enumeration count, applicability filtering, denominator-set assignment, schema conformance of every record, void-re-run behaviour, and seeded-order determinism
Self-check wired into npm test
A2prime per-run budget logging: each run logs pass/fail against ±20% token+wall-clock tolerance constants; token budget binds first on conflict; hard-truncation at upper bound
Bare-harness anti-strawman validation: >=25% of pilot tasks solved; pre-registered and frozen bare-harness config (pilot scope)
Task corpus: N_tasks=24, stratified 8 categories, acceptance scripts harness-owned+read-only+hash-checked, committed+frozen before first run (corpus authorship scope)
Injection at identical logical point: immediately before first agent action on the task (injection-point enforcement)

openQuestions.q: Is A2prime ±20% budget enforcement and per-run pass/fail logging in scope for this driver story, or deferred to the run-ablation/engine layer? The §7 schema does not include a budget-compliance field, but §1 says each A2prime run logs pass/fail against the token+wall-clock constants. CHK-002 covers the §7 schema fields but does not name this logging requirement.
openQuestions.evidence: §1 A2prime: each run logs pass/fail against these constants. Hard-truncation cap at the upper bound.
